title: Hold a conveyancer's licence
what: Hold a conveyancer's licence before carrying on business as a conveyancer for fee or reward (legal practitioners excepted).

sources.title: Conveyancing Act 2004 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is not a legal practitioner must not carry on business as a conveyancer for fee or reward unless – (a) the person is the holder of a licence granted by the Director in accordance with this Division;
